title: Event curation (tone, scope, hide)
description: Curated overrides for world events returned by the Korean Wikipedia source (docs/plans/m3a2-world-events-api.md, section 'curation file format'). An entry matches an event when 'date' is equal and either 'primary_link' equals the event's primary link (underscore and space treated as the same) or 'summary_contains' is a substring of the event summary. 'hide' is only for rights-holder requests or clearly wrong lines, never for awkward or minor wording.

date.description: Event date (YYYY-MM-DD), same as the event's date.

primary_link.description: Canonical title of the event's primary link (first link title after redirect resolution). Null when matching by summary_contains only.

summary_contains.description: Substring of the event summary. Null when matching by primary_link only.

scope.description: Optional curated scope. When absent, scope comes from Wikidata P17.

hide.description: true removes the event from the response. Only for rights-holder requests or clearly wrong lines.

reason.description: Facts only (what the line is, why the tone/scope/hide value). No judgement of sentence quality.

evidence_url.description: Evidence link, for Wikipedia lines a revision-pinned URL (oldid).
